evaluation.label: Ordinal Kp and ap · retrospective L1 evaluation
evaluation.sample: Matched three-hour GFZ intervals with complete inputs for both model versions; leads +1…48 h.
notes: GFZ Kp/ap is definitive for September and October and provisional for November in the frozen archive.
Replay uses assumed archive availability. Actual provider receipt times were unavailable.
Kp ≥6 occurred in only two target intervals. Threat and Heidke scores use a probability cutoff of 0.5.
